'''Kontomire-dandelion stew''' is a stew that heals {{Hp|12}} and grants {{EffectLink|Strength}} for 5 minutes and {{EffectLink|Regeneration}} for 1 minute.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/crafting/kontomire_stew.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
[[Tomatoes]], a dandelion, a fern, a [[Cooked Fish|cooked fish]] or [[Cooked Large Fish|cooked large fish]], an egg and a [[bowl]]. Picking up tomatoes or a bowl unlocks the recipe.

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating it takes 1.6 seconds, heals {{Hp|12}} and gives Strength I for 5:00 and Regeneration I for 1:00. The bowl is given back.

=== Trading ===
It is one of the foods a villager can ask for as its [[favorite food]].

== History ==
{{History|

}}

== Trivia ==
* Kontomire stew is a Ghanaian dish made with cocoyam leaves. The changelog: "DON'T BE MAD--listen--ferns were the closest thing I could think of to cocoyam".<ref>{{Cite changelog|1.10|quote=Kontomire-Dandelion Stew (DON'T BE MAD--listen--ferns were the closest thing I could think of to cocoyam)}}</ref>
